about.description: Phoenix VIII is a beachfront condo property in Orange Beach offering direct access to the Gulf of Mexico with Gulf-front balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows. Features spacious 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals with fully furnished interiors, open layouts, and private balconies. Each luxury condo faces the water with expansive Gulf-front balconies.
about.elevator_pitch: A beachfront Orange Beach condo with direct Gulf access, luxury 1-3 bedroom units, and resort-style amenities for families and couples.
